data.long_description:
Introducing a luxurious 2-bedroom apartment for sale in the iconic Barcelo Residences (Al Dar Tower), Dubai Marina. Situated on a high floor, this corner unit boasts stunning canal and partial sea views, offering a serene and sophisticated living experience. The property features serviced residences and world-class amenities, providing the utmost convenience and comfort. Ready to move in, the apartment includes a spacious balcony perfect for relaxing while enjoying the surrounding views.
